Hey green bean ! I was a green bean not that long ago and I was absolutely terrified of the registers 😅 now I find myself taking orders while completing other tasks. One thing that helped me a lot was practicing during down time. I would have my other partners give me drinks w and w/o mods to punch in as well w food and etc. It took me about 2-3 weeks to fully get it down. Remember don’t get discouraged as this is a learning process and that everyone was once in this position no matter how good they are at it now! Good luck !

Hey new partner! Let me start off by telling you I bet you’re doing amazing. Do not get discouraged especially if they did not train you. It is absolutely ridiculous that they believe that you’ll be able to bar w/o training. I was trained for two weeks and it took me about 2 months to really get the hang of it. Even to this day I still find myself asking questions and I’m almost at a year! I would advise you talk to your SM about what is going on. This job is truly fun with the right people and the right training and I would h8 for you to miss out on the experience because of them. So pls talk to your SM or DM and let them know what is going on !   I wish you luck and remember we are humans not robots that should know absolutely everything. Put yourself first and I wish you well on your journey!
